summary: At segment 0 step 20, a three-turn Passes_walls timeout should print "You are feeling rather flabby." before decrementing. JavaScript skips timeout.c:phaze_dialogue(), leaving the message row blank while RNG and cursor match. Port the whole warning helper and nh_timeout caller, preserving odd countdown selection and suppression by extrinsic or permanent intrinsic sources. This helper does not cancel occupations.

source.branch: nh_timeout calls phaze_dialogue for any HPasses_walls & TIMEOUT, after levitation_dialogue and before region_dialogue and property decrements. The helper computes i=timeout/2 using C integer truncation, returns for any EPasses_walls or HPasses_walls & ~TIMEOUT, and prints only odd values with i in 1..2: timeout 5 uses "You start to feel bloated."; timeout 3 uses "You are feeling rather flabby." Both use ordinary pline. Even, timeout-one and larger counts are silent. It does not inspect blocked, draw RNG, mutate state, or call stop_occupation.
